gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {寝付|ねつ}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep
definitions.explanation: To transition from being awake to being asleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧{寝付|ねつ}いた。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{寝付|ねつ}いた。
⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{寝付|ねつ}けなくて⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I had trouble falling asleep and it was a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}くて→暑い：00619_atsui⟧{寝付|ねつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The hot weather has made it hard to fall asleep for days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{寝付|ねつ}けなかった。
examples.english: I was worried about tomorrow's exam and couldn't fall asleep at night.

notes:
{寝付|ねつ}く is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to fall asleep.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to sleep) + ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to attach, to settle) → to settle into sleep

ASPECT (ている):
{寝付|ねつ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of being asleep (having fallen asleep).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{寝付|ねつ}けない (can't fall asleep easily)
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{寝付|ねつ}いた (finally fell asleep)
- {寝付|ねつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (easy/hard to fall asleep)
- ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧{寝付|ねつ}く (fall asleep quickly)

RELATED WORDS:
- {寝付|ねつ}き: the ability to fall asleep; {寝付|ねつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ = falls asleep easily

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧: to sleep (more general)
- ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to go to bed, to sleep
- {寝付|ねつ}く specifically refers to the act of falling asleep

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse {寝付|ねつ}く with ⟦{根付|ねづ}く→根付く：13113_nezuku⟧ (to take root, to become established), which is written with ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧ "root" and read ねづく: ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{根付|ねづ}く→根付く：13113_nezuku⟧ (a habit takes hold).
